overview: Iteration 1: DB-backed settings foundation. Migrate all 4 JSON config files (site-settings, operating-hours, chat-settings, time-slots) to a Neon Postgres site_settings table. Make getSiteSettings() async and DB-backed. Decouple remaining hardcoded cafe name from push notifications and AI waiter prompt. Add smoke test scripts and Vitest unit tests.
goals: Move all server-side JSON config to Neon Postgres (Vercel ephemeral FS has no write persistence)
Make getSiteSettings() and writeSiteSettings() async and DB-backed
Decouple all remaining hardcoded Makan Moments references from runtime code
Add a SPIRAL-compatible smoke test report script
Add Vitest unit tests with npm run test

userStories.title: Add smoke test report script
userStories.description: Create test-reports/ directory and scripts/generate-test-report.mjs that hits localhost:3031 and writes a SPIRAL-compatible report.json with passed/failed/errored counts.
acceptanceCriteria: test-reports/ in .gitignore (with .gitkeep exception)
scripts/generate-test-report.mjs writes test-reports/<timestamp>/report.json
Report shape: { summary: { passed, failed, errored, total }, tests: [...] }
Smoke tests: GET /en, GET /en/menu, GET /api/settings — all expect 200
npm run build passes
technicalNotes: Use fetch() with AbortSignal.timeout for each URL
Exit 1 if any failed or errored

userStories.title: Pre-order submission verification script
userStories.description: Create scripts/verify-order-submit.mjs that POSTs a clearly-marked test order to /api/orders and confirms 201 + order ID. Update .env.example with WhatsApp vars.
acceptanceCriteria: Script prints PASS: Order saved — ID: <id> on HTTP 201
Test item: { id: 'TEST-VERIFY', nameEn: 'VERIFY TEST — DELETE ME', price: 1.00, quantity: 1 }
estimatedArrival at least 30 min in the future
.env.example documents WAITER_WHATSAPP_NUMBER, WHATSAPP_API_URL, WHATSAPP_API_KEY
npm run build passes
technicalNotes: Prints reminder to delete test order from /admin > Orders tab

userStories.title: Migrate all settings from JSON files to Neon Postgres site_settings table
userStories.description: Create site_settings table (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value JSONB). Make getSiteSettings() async + DB-backed. Update all callers. Wire admin and public settings APIs to read/write DB. Create seed script.
acceptanceCriteria: site_settings table created idempotently in src/lib/site-settings.ts
scripts/seed-settings.mjs seeds all 4 keys (site, operating_hours, chat, time_slots) from existing JSON files
getSiteSettings() is now async and returns Promise<SiteSettings>
writeSiteSettings() is now async and upserts into DB
src/app/api/admin/settings/route.ts uses await getSiteSettings() and await writeSiteSettings()
src/app/api/settings/route.ts uses await getSiteSettings()
middleware.ts root-redirect uses await getSiteSettings()
npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors
technicalNotes: SQL: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value
Seed script loads .env.local if present for DATABASE_URL
knowledge/ files read via readFileSync (static assets, fine on Vercel)
data/*.json files remain as backup/seed source — not read at runtime

userStories.title: Add Vitest + npm run test with unit tests
userStories.description: Install vitest, create vitest.config.ts with @/ alias scoped to src/, add src/tests/unit/utils.test.ts with unit tests. Wire 'test': 'vitest run' in package.json.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json has 'test': 'vitest run' script
